preconditions.description: The number of bases n must be between 2 and 500,000, and k must be at least 2 and at most n.
Each base's coordinates must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
All bases must be unique, and one of them must be at the origin (0, 0).

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximal sum of distances between all pairs of the remaining k bases.
